newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest starts coverage on gaming.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest starts coverage on gaming.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities Ltd analyst Damon Brundage has started coverage on Circus Circus Enterprises Inc, MGM Grand Inc, ITT Corp, Harrah's Entertainment Inc, Primadonna Resorts Inc, Rio Hotel & Casino Inc with hold ratings.
-- He rates Mirage Resorts Inc at accumulate.

-- Brundage told Reuters he based the ratings, in general, on his belief room occupancy levels in Las Vegas are at or near their peak and increases in room rates will start to flatten or decline. Also, he does not think Atlantic City will become a destination and entertainment resort like Las Vegas.
